annuity-certain-pv.name: Annuity Certain Present Value
annuity-certain-pv.intro: Compute the present value of a certain annuity used as the basis for premium pricing.

annuity-nsp.name: Net Single Premium from Annuity Factor
annuity-nsp.intro: Derive the net single premium from the annual benefit and the annuity-due factor.

annuity-present.name: Annuity Present Value Calculator
annuity-present.intro: Calculate the present value of ordinary and annuity-due cash flows for insurance planning.

average-severity.name: Average Claim Severity
average-severity.intro: Divide total claims by claim count to get the average severity per claim.

calc-1.name: Waiver-of-Premium Present Value
calc-1.intro: Discount future waived premiums to present value for reserve calculation.

calc-pv-1.name: Discounted Present Value (Valuation Rate)
calc-pv-1.intro: Discount cash flows at the preset valuation interest rate.

claim-frequency.name: Claim Frequency per Exposure Unit
claim-frequency.intro: Measure expected claim counts per unit of risk exposure.

claim-reserve.name: Claims Reserve Calculator
claim-reserve.intro: Estimate the ultimate claims and the reserve needed for outstanding claims.

combined-ratio.name: Combined Ratio
combined-ratio.intro: Sum the loss ratio and expense ratio to gauge underwriting profitability.

complete-life-expectancy.name: Complete Life Expectancy
complete-life-expectancy.intro: Sum yearly survival probabilities to obtain the complete expectation of life.

endowment-premium.name: Endowment Insurance Premium
endowment-premium.intro: Price an endowment policy combining death and maturity benefits.

estimate-20.name: Cash Surrender Value Estimator
estimate-20.intro: Estimate the surrender (cash) value of a policy after fees and reserves.

expected-claim-loss.name: Expected Claim Loss
expected-claim-loss.intro: Compute expected loss as claim frequency multiplied by average severity.

expense-ratio.name: Expense Ratio
expense-ratio.intro: Divide operating expenses by earned premium to assess cost efficiency.

force-of-mortality.name: Force of Mortality
force-of-mortality.intro: Derive the continuous force of mortality from the one-year survival probability.

gross-premium-loading.name: Gross Premium with Loading
gross-premium-loading.intro: Add expense and profit loadings to the net premium to obtain the gross premium.

ibnr-estimate.name: IBNR Estimate
ibnr-estimate.intro: Estimate incurred-but-not-reported reserves from ultimate claims and paid ratio.

ibnr-reserve.name: IBNR Reserve
ibnr-reserve.intro: Calculate incurred-but-not-reported reserves for long-tail liabilities.

level-premium-life.name: Level Annual Premium (Single-Premium Amortization)
level-premium-life.intro: Amortize a single premium into level annual payments using the annuity factor.

life-cover-need.name: Life Cover Need (Income Replacement)
life-cover-need.intro: Estimate required life cover using the income-replacement approach.

loss-ratio.name: Loss Ratio
loss-ratio.intro: Ratio of incurred claims to earned premium, a core underwriting metric.

mortality-prob.name: Mortality Probability
mortality-prob.intro: Infer the mortality rate q from the survival probability p.

mortality-table.name: Life Table Lookup
mortality-table.intro: Look up deaths (lx x qx) and survival figures from a life table.

net-single-premium.name: Net Single Premium
net-single-premium.intro: One-time pure premium covering only the insurance benefit, no expenses.

premium-calc.name: Premium Calculator
premium-calc.intro: Compute premium as sum assured multiplied by the applicable rate.

premium-elasticity.name: Premium Demand Elasticity
premium-elasticity.intro: Measure how demand responds to a change in premium rate.

pure-premium.name: Pure Premium
pure-premium.intro: Expected loss equals claim frequency multiplied by average severity.

pure-premium-rate.name: Pure Premium Rate
pure-premium-rate.intro: Divide expected loss by exposure units to obtain the pure rate.

stats-5.name: Claims Ratio Statistics
stats-5.intro: Compute the incurred-to-reported claims ratio for portfolio monitoring.

surrender-value.name: Cash Value (Reserve x Surrender Ratio)
surrender-value.intro: Derive cash value as reserve multiplied by the surrender ratio.

survival-prob-t.name: t-Year Survival Probability
survival-prob-t.intro: Compute the t-year survival probability from the number of survivors.

uw-margin.name: Underwriting Margin
uw-margin.intro: Back out the underwriting profit margin from the combined ratio.

uw-profit.name: Underwriting Profit
uw-profit.intro: Underwriting profit equals premium minus claims minus expenses.
